diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with no termination condition (until: null), but the JoI includes a break statement that terminates after the first iteration. F2 shows the IR emitted an action at 3600000 ms while the JoI emitted nothing because it had already terminated. This matches Example E in the instructions where an added break caused the candidate to fail on subsequent iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the break statement to preserve the IR's repeating cycle behavior. The IR has no termination condition, so the JoI must not terminate either. The condition check and action remain identical; only the break was removed.
